1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.518 of 2022, under Section 342, 354Kha, 504,
363, 376, 511 IPC & Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, P.S. Mallawan, District Hardoi.

3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that on 29.11.2022 daughter of the informant aged about 3 years was going to her grandparents' home when the applicant caught hold of her with an intent to commit wrong and subsequently, it was revealed that the applicant had removed the underpant of the victim.
4.
Initially, the FIR was lodged under Section 354 IPC.
Subsequently, during trial the offence under Section 376 IPC was added.
In view thereof, counsel for the applicant draws my attention to the medical report on record which does not indicate any injury and the hymen was also found to be intact.
5. In the light of the said, it is argued that the applicant is being falsely prosecuted.
Age of the applicant is around 23 years and he has no criminal antecedents.
6. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

7. Considering the medical on record which prima-facie does not indicate the offence under Section 3/5 of POCSO Act and in the worst case, can be said to be an offence under Section 7/8 of POCSO Act which is punishable for a term less than five years coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.
